notes.title: If you love HP Love Craft Support this game!
notes.content:
Rise of the Elders: Cthulhu

You can check out their Kickstarter here:

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/810027085/rise-of-the-elders-cthulhu

The project is somewhere at the crossroad between XCOM: EU, Eldritch Horror and The Call of Cthulhu. A game that has the accessibility of a video game, the tactical challenge of a board game and the flavor of a good old-fashioned tabletop RPG. 
 
Planned release : October 2017
Game mode: single-player offline
Language: English (more languages to be announced)
Supported platforms: PC, Android, iOS

notes.title: New Enemy Implemented from the Nightmare Realm
notes.content: Hello everybody, I hope all is well. The new enemy has finally been implemented. I have posted two new screen shots for those that want to see what they will look like. A blind flying entity of some sort hovers in the sky. It is impervious to bullets, and now you will have to keep track of your shots as the sound of gunfire draws this being. When it senses you are close enough it summons a wailing severed head that chases you and when close enough can damage you and hinder your vision for 10 seconds. Goodluck to you guys!

notes.title: Chat system implemented into main menu
notes.content: Hello everybody I have included a big update of including chat into the main menu. I implemented this in hopes of allowing the community to be able to help each other out in beating the game, as the game is pretty vague on purpose. I hope this will allow for a more close knit community that will help those who are   unsure of some of the games mechanics. The chat has no limits in who can talk, and what country they can be from. The only limit is that only 20 players at a time can enter this global chat. If I notice that more players are using the chat, I will opt for a service that can include more players. Enjoy communicating!

notes.title: Update! Food, new weapon, health packs, & scavenging emphasis
notes.content:
Adding multiplayer was a big update, but this update has definitely surpassed that accomplishment.
I have added many building and areas to flesh out the surrounding areas around the base. There is now a food stat, in which the player will be required to search the buildings, huts, containers, and other areas to find food. Scavenging the buildings will also yield the chance to run into health packs and ammo for assault rifle. This will be a welcome addition as healing wasn't possible unless saving the game. A new weapon, an assault rifle, will be a welcome addition. With the addition of this weapon I have had to lower the fire rate of the primary weapon to balance the game out. This weapon will require scavenging for bullets, as the gas bullet maker is only for the primary weapon. The day night cycle has also been altered to start on daytime when starting a new game. With all these changes NOA has become a more hardcore survival experience. Enjoy!

Other Changes
-Inclusion of a turret that will shoot silent ones that try to break down your door
-Tweak of flashlight area of light 
-Fall Damage Inclusion

notes.title: Multiplayer is live!!
notes.content: Nightmare on Azathoth now has multiplayer! You can enter another players world from the perspective of an unknown enemy. You control this invisible unknown enemy, and you can summon a new big silent enemy that is invincible to the players attack. The catch is that this enemy will only last 30 seconds, and has a pretty long cool down before you can summon it again. I still need to implement a single stat the keeps track of how many players you have affected. Also it might be hard to find another playing as looking at the steam stats of concurrent players at any time not many playing at playing at once. If you have a friend it'd be advisable to have them play with you, until the user base of NOA's multiplayer becomes bigger. Hope you guys enjoy!

notes.title: Update on Multiplayer progress
notes.content: I have made a good amount of headway into implementing multiplayer into NOA. I will try to get it up asap as I will update it accordingly, based on feedback. So far the invader will enter an altered version of your world, and they will be able to summon silent ones. They will do their best to try to kill you and give you jump scares, as I will be creating a new stat of keeping track of how many players you have killed. This gameplay was greatly inspired by my admiration for dark souls. I will try to get multiplayer up by this weekend!

notes.title: Exciting new Update/Features/ New Tailer from the nightmare realm
notes.content:
NOA might have released on the 30th, but I feel today is its official launch day. I made the mistake of releasing the game out a bit too early without refining and including the final features I wanted. Now I can offically say all the main things I want in the game are implemented. The future is bright for NOA as I will continually add new content to the game.

New updates:

The official trailer that shows more of what the game is about is now live.

The nightmare has been altered! A small village has now appeared out of nowhere. Fuel is an important resource to collect in NOA and the regular way of collecting it inside your base is pretty slow. With the new feature of a new hover robot and the village, there is a much faster way of collecting fuel by going to the village trying to find fuel cases. When finding fuel cases you can send your hover craft to collect them. This provides a more engaging way of collecting fuel. The towners that live there are pretty harmless but killing them all can have pretty dire consequence. 

AI, Animations tweaks, base layout, weapon change, and new settings all make this a much different game than when first released.

Bug fixes 
-Start menu mouse being twitchy
-AI fixes
-Physics changes

notes.title: Major updates from the Nightmare realm!
notes.content: Updates to NOA regarding animation, base layout, physics, UI, and small tweaks to silent ones AI are now live. I greatly appreciate all the feedback and reviews, and I will continue to work on making Azathoth a bettter experience. I would've liked to have implemented new things, but I finished making all these changes last week but due to an update issue with the game engine a lot of bugs popped upped that I had to do alot of back tracking. The game is at a better state than when it launched, and I will now work on implementing what could make the game a better experience. Thanks for the patience, I greatly appreciate it.
